external_sources.title: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design
external_sources.source_type: Author-posted original research manuscript; author publication record; official research repository
external_sources.inspection: Selected full-text design, threat model, non-goals, evaluation, and limitations. Official repository caveat inspected; code not run.
external_sources.version_note: Author record lists SaTML 2026. This packet cites pinned v2; numerical results were not reconciled across versions and are not used.
external_sources.supports: Capability and dependency checks around susceptible models, with explicit threat boundaries.
external_sources.does_not_support: Solved prompt injection, protected compromised memory, universally truthful output, or production security of the research interpreter.

external_sources.title: AgentHarm: A Benchmark for Measuring Harmfulness of LLM Agents
external_sources.inspection: Metadata, abstract, and selected full-text direct-misuse, synthetic-tool, and scoring design sections.
external_sources.access_note: OpenReview forum and PDF returned browser challenges. This packet uses the accessible pinned preprint and makes no review-status inference from that access failure.
external_sources.supports: Direct multi-step misuse evaluation distinct from indirect prompt injection.
external_sources.does_not_support: Actual real-world harmful acts or general harmlessness certification.
